c0.scope: Historical single-PE DSP48E2 C0, integer reference and six fault cases; bind the new candidate wrapper before use

tile.scope: 8x16 quant tile, INT32 prefixes, Bias/RQ, reset/flush/bubble/stall/credit and sixteen faults; not complete GEMM/network

rq_owner.scope: RQ ownership, wrap/credit, concurrent push/pop, reset/flush and faults; not full network

act_ram.scope: ACT byte/wide ports, keep/masks, collisions, backpressure and faults; candidate wide memory also needs real_bram

wide_gemm.scope: Nine representative GEMM shapes, continuous jobs, 2101 outputs, protocol errors and six faults

real_bram.scope: Actual BRAM/address/Bias/RQ/writeback, 2086 Golden plus 2086 host values, PACK/LB and memory errors; requires --wide-summary

shared_path.scope: Actual DMA/shared ACT/wide GEMM/MOVE/QK-packed/WB/host, 321 outputs and 5550 host reads, backpressure and bad_expected; no encoder auxiliary chain

fsm.scope: FSM instruction/load/compute scheduling self-check; bind candidate scheduler

dma.scope: AXI read protocol and byte writer local regressions; actual 128 integration requires shared_path

softmax15.scope: Exact Softmax15 frozen-score replay: 36 groups, 7092 rows, 1397124 values; not the separate 32-iteration Softmax runner

layernorm.scope: Frozen V4 LayerNorm module Golden and faults; match candidate source hashes

av_q14.scope: Q14 AV decomposition, 197-token shape, tail/signed/saturation and drop_high fault

gelu.scope: Frozen GELU LUT all 256 addresses and long vectors

residual.scope: V4 scaled wide residual addition and saturation; --generate-only NEW_DIR generates vectors only

move.scope: Tensor move/layout local TB; bind candidate source

new128_encoder_path.scope: MISSING: independent new128 LN→QK→Softmax15→Q14AV→projection/residual→GELU/FC path. Reference runners use old 16-lane GEMM and cannot grant this coverage. Until implemented, require full12 fallback.
new128_encoder_path.prepare_only: Old encoder --prepare-only is a structural reference, not new128 validation

full12.scope: New128 full12, 257 checkpoints / 11532400 values / 1000 actual host results plus two specific faults and actual cycle accounting; normal shutdown/protection required
full12.prepare_only: --prepare-only creates a new private preparation and does not start vendor tools
